subject.title: fix: preserve BOOTSTRAP.md in preseeded workspaces (#91931)

question: Should a workspace with `BOOTSTRAP.md` present and no `setupCompletedAt` remain pending despite customized profile files or preseeded workspace skills?
rationale: Both interpretations protect real shipped workflows: the current heuristic repairs stale bootstrap files, while the proposed rule prevents managed deployments from silently skipping first-run onboarding.

options.title: Accept the narrowed evidence rule
options.body: Treat pending `BOOTSTRAP.md` as authoritative and require `memory/`, `MEMORY.md`, explicit deletion, or recorded completion before setup completes.

options.title: Require an explicit managed mode
options.body: Preserve existing profile-diff repair by default and introduce a maintainer-approved managed-workspace mode with upgrade documentation and tests.

options.title: Pause the behavioral change
options.body: Keep the linked bug open if the compatibility cost of changing the global heuristic is not currently acceptable.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrowed evidence rule
recommendation.body: Treat pending `BOOTSTRAP.md` as authoritative and require `memory/`, `MEMORY.md`, explicit deletion, or recorded completion before setup completes.
